_doc: PRE-REGISTRATION for H80 rung 1, SEALED AND COMMITTED BEFORE THE PROBE RAN. Cycle 23, 2026-08-28. Any deviation from this file must be logged as a deviation in experiments/log.md, not silently absorbed.
title: Barrier-crossing search: structure-aware destroy + exact-gain rebuild + an acceptance schedule that lets the search STAY worse

novelty.admitted_under: killed.json H31 revival_if, verbatim: 'The destroy operator is STRUCTURE-AWARE (SCC-, block- or cycle-guided) rather than random, and the rebuild is exact-gain. Distinct mechanism.' This is queue item H40, filed 2026-08-16 and never built; H80 supersedes it by adding the acceptance schedule and by sizing it.
standing_counter_evidence_named_before_r: H17 is deferred-not-falsified on the BASIN-HOPPING axis with the note 'reachability, not stability, is the barrier'. M16 (cycle 22) has since MEASURED that reachability barrier as a 409x contraction of the starting basin, so H17's deferral is STRONGER now than when it was written. H80 is distinct from H17 in being a discrete acceptance schedule on the champion's own refiner rather than a continuous re-optimization from a perturbed init - but the headwind is real and is recorded here before any number exists.
M15: no partial adoption of the reference is profitable and the blend path runs through a 0.786 pp valley.

M13/H66: the H64 champion order has EXACTLY 0.000000 pp of repair headroom under the champion's own stage-4 move classes, so a perturb-and-repair that lands back inside that image gains nothing by construction. H80's answer is that it does not repair-and-keep-if-better; it accepts worse states and travels.
M8: a new move class must clear the marginal rate of the stage it is inserted into (connectome stage 4 = 3.45e-4 pp/s) and must report its redundancy fraction.
M12: a from-champion prototype OVERSTATES an inner-stage change. Rung 1 is therefore run on a PROXY, not from the champion order.

correction_to_the_queue_item_made_before.what: H80's method says rung 1 should 'measure whether an acceptance schedule recovers gap that the monotone sift cannot' on gap.make_hard_synthetic_graph, citing a '+0.80 pp verified gap'.
correction_to_the_queue_item_made_before.why_it_is_wrong: That +0.80 pp is the H21-era gap measured at the ROCKET level (experiments/log.md:1057). At the SIFT level the synthetic has NO gap left: proto_h31_lns.json records gap_sift_to_ref = -0.4493 / -0.5764 / -0.0313 pp on seeds 42/123/999, i.e. the sift is ALREADY ABOVE the synthetic's reference order. 'Recovered fraction of the gap' is therefore an undefined statistic on this proxy and must not be the primary.
correction_to_the_queue_item_made_before.what_replaces_it: ARM-VS-ARM deltas at matched refinement wall-clock. There IS genuine ground above the sift on this proxy - H31 took +0.1987 / +0.2840 / +0.2623 pp of it - so the proxy discriminates. The synthetic reference is retained for ONE diagnostic only (the blend-path barrier depth), never as a target.

design.framing: A 2x2 factorial that separates the two ingredients H80 conflates - DESTROY STRUCTURE x ACCEPTANCE RULE - plus a baseline and a harness positive control. Every arm starts from the SAME sift fixed point and gets the SAME refinement wall budget.

arms.A0_sift_only: H02 greedy-FAS -> Rocket -> sift to fixed point. The monotone baseline every other arm is measured against.
arms.A1p_ils_lns_production: POSITIVE CONTROL for the harness: mfas.refine.ils_lns(mode='ruin'), the production H31 refiner, at H31's own settings. Its job is to reproduce proto_h31_lns.json to within noise; if it does not, the harness is broken and every other number in this file is void.
arms.A1_topk_greedy: my loop, destroy = k victims sampled without replacement with probability proportional to current back-edge weight, acceptance = keep iff strictly better. H31 re-implemented inside the common harness.
arms.A2_struct_greedy: my loop, destroy = STRUCTURE-AWARE (seed sampled prop. to back-edge weight, then BFS over the BACK-EDGE subgraph until k nodes are collected - a cycle-dense, feedback-connected victim set), acceptance = keep iff strictly better. This is H40 exactly: structure alone.
arms.A3_struct_anneal: my loop, destroy = structure-aware, acceptance = Metropolis with geometric cooling T0 -> T0/100 over the budget. THIS IS H80.
arms.A4_topk_anneal: my loop, destroy = top-k back-weight sampling, acceptance = Metropolis. Acceptance alone, without structure - the fourth cell.

design.rebuild: Exact-gain sequential (Gauss-Seidel) re-insertion of every victim via mfas.refine.lns.apply_victim_reinsertions, then a SHORT 2-sweep production sift. Identical for every arm, so the arms differ ONLY in destroy and acceptance.
design.leakage: Every destroy choice and every acceptance decision is computed from input edge weights + current ranks only. The Metropolis delta uses a self-contained numpy feedforward-weight function of (src, tgt, w, rank) - a pure function of the INPUT, carrying no privileged information - and the FROZEN oracle (mfas.metrics.score_from_order) is called only to score whole candidate vectors for best-by-oracle tracking and for reporting, exactly as ils_lns already does. data/best_solution is never read. The synthetic reference_order is read ONLY by the barrier diagnostic, never by any arm.
design.temperature_sizing_is_target_blind: T0 is NOT taken from M15's 0.786 pp. Each arm calibrates on its OWN instance: from the sift fixed point, n_cal proposals are generated and rejected, and delta_med = median |cand_pct - cur_pct| over downhill proposals is recorded. The grid is T0 in {0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8} x delta_med. Calibration time is charged to the arm's own wall budget. M15's number is used ONLY to interpret the result afterwards.
design.matched_work: All arms share one refinement wall budget per instance (30 s at n=400 and on mouse, 120 s at n=4000), and the round count and accepted-move count of every arm are reported alongside, so a wall-matched result can also be read as work-matched.

S2_hard_synthetic_n4000.why: SCALE CHECK. H31 won on the n=400 synthetic (+0.25 pp) and LOST on the connectome (-0.0008 pp). A synthetic win at one size is therefore known NOT to transfer; a 10x scale-up is the cheapest available test of whether the advantage is a small-instance artefact before any GPU is spent.

S3_mouse.why: a real graph, n=148. H31 found EXACTLY 0.0000 pp here.

primary_statistic: delta_A3 = mean over the 3 seeds of [ best A3 over the T0 grid ] - max(A0, A1, A2) per seed, in pp, on S1 and on S2.
diagnostics_reported_regardless_of_verdi: n_uphill_accepted per arm and per T0 - the schedule's own liveness check

max_excursion_pp = max over the trajectory of (best_ever_pct - current_pct): HOW DEEP THE SEARCH ACTUALLY WENT. This is the number that makes a null quantitative rather than merely negative - it says how far short of the barrier a feasible schedule falls.
barrier_depth_pp on S1/S2: the minimum over t of the blend path (1-t)*rank(A0 order) + t*rank(synthetic reference), the same instrument H78 used on connectome. DIAGNOSTIC ONLY.
delta_med (the calibration scale) per instance, and the ratio max_excursion_pp / barrier_depth_pp

kill_condition._note: Rung 1 is NECESSARY, NOT SUFFICIENT: H31 passed a synthetic rung of this exact shape and then failed the connectome screen, so a PASS here buys only the right to spend one connectome run, while a FAIL is decisive.
H80_dies_at_rung_1_if_any_of: K1. n_uphill_accepted == 0 at EVERY T0 in the grid on S1 - the schedule never crosses anything, so it is mis-sized and the arm is VOID rather than negative (this is the item's own stated void condition).
K2. delta_A3 < +0.05 pp on S1 (mean over 3 seeds).
K3. the T0 that wins on S1 is a SINGLETON - fewer than 2 adjacent grid points individually beat max(A0,A1,A2) in the 3-seed mean. A single lucky grid point is not a mechanism.
K4. delta_A3 <= 0 on S2. A gain that exists at n=400 and is gone at n=4000 is a small-instance artefact and will not survive n=136,648 (H31's own history).
kill_condition.H40_is_separately_adjudicated: If A2 - A1 >= +0.05 pp on BOTH S1 and S2 while A3 fails, then STRUCTURE-AWARE DESTROY passes on its own and H40 - not H80 - becomes the item that proceeds to rung 2. Recorded here so a partial result cannot be re-narrated afterwards as whichever arm happened to win.

rung_2_if_rung_1_passes.what: ONE connectome screen of the winning configuration composed onto the H64 champion stack as a terminal stage, at --role implement, inside the 3600 s runtime invariant, with the raw sift score reported separately (CLAUDE.md) and the M8 redundancy fraction reported.
rung_2_if_rung_1_passes.kill_condition: |connectome delta| < 0.012 pp (screen_delta_pp), or any run exceeds 3600 s at a setting that shows signal.
rung_2_if_rung_1_passes.note: microns is in_screen: false (campaign.yaml, operator decision 2026-08-26), so the screen is connectome + mouse.

predicted_effect_before_running.connectome_delta_pp: -0.01 to +0.05, midpoint +0.005 - inherited verbatim from the queue item, which said BEFORE this cycle that the median case is below the bar
predicted_effect_before_running.most_likely_outcome_stated_in_advance: K2 or K4. The arithmetic is written down here so it cannot be produced after the fact: if a round costs ~30 ms at n=400 and the median downhill proposal costs delta_med, then crossing a barrier D deep requires roughly D/delta_med consecutive accepted uphill moves, whose probability at T = c*delta_med is about exp(-D/(c*delta_med)). For the connectome's measured D = 0.786 pp that is negligible at any c small enough to still descend. The experiment's job is to MEASURE max_excursion_pp and turn that argument into a number, not to assume it.
